exec: pm.test('Response has success=false and a message', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Contains the new application', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.some(a => a._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('applicationId'))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Has stats, eligible, closing lists', () => { pm.expect(d.stats).to.have.property('eligible'); pm.expect(d.eligible).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.closing).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('12 monthly buckets, series aligned', () => { pm.expect(d.labels.length).to.eql(12); pm.expect(d.applications.length).to.eql(12); });
